text:
[Act: insolvency
 Chapter: Administration and Distribution of the Estate of the Bankrupt
 Section: 156::Delivery of property and documents to bankruptcy trustee.
]


The bankrupt, his banker or agent or any other person having possession of any property, books, papers or other records which bankruptcy trustee is required to take possession for the purposes of the bankruptcy process shall deliver the said property and documents to the bankruptcy trustee.
